title: lint.py exits 0 and lints nothing for a path outside kb/ or a kb/_self doc, since its no-file refusal exempts any existing kb path and any path git has history for
goal: lint.py given an argument that selects no article of any root (a _tools/ file, README.md, kb/ itself) exits non-zero naming it, as BG-wrzxhd4q's goal says; only the kb/_self docs and deleted articles a landing passes (bl_land.changed_articles) stay exempt, and the HOME history fallback goes (SP-7nv2ffr2 review); test_live_kb.py's lint test asserts that a kb/<root>/<path> argument lints the planted article and names its finding, so a qualified() that stopped rewriting the prefix fails the suite (absorbs ST-3g3snqb5)

run: import subprocess,sys;l='.claude/skills/kb-verify/lint.py';c=[subprocess.run([sys.executable,l,a],capture_output=True,text=True).returncode for a in ('_tools/check.py','README.md','kb/')];e=subprocess.run([sys.executable,l,'kb/_self/tools.md'],capture_output=True,text=True).returncode;sys.exit(0 if all(c) and e==0 else 1)
